post_validation_rule: Phase-2 arms on MAIN VALIDATION are POST_VALIDATION_EXPLORATORY; Phase-2 selection uses CALIB only; Q1-Q8 on RETRO_TEST are CONFIRMATORY_P2 (PREREGISTERED_FOLLOWUP) with disclosure D-a; Q9-Q14 are TERTIARY_P2; the Phase-1 post_validation_rule of ALL_METHODS_LOCK is unchanged and Phase-2 items never enter the Phase-1 registry.

Q1.rule: SUCCESS iff the 95% CI lower bound > 0 and both per-seed points > 0; EQUIVALENT iff the 90% paired user-bootstrap percentile CI lies inside [-0.0005, 0.0005] (TOST, alpha 0.05); FAILURE iff the 95% CI upper bound < 0; INCONCLUSIVE otherwise (PREG2 §9.4, D-h). The CALIB tie band 0.001 is a different role and never applies here.

Q13.rule: TOST at alpha 0.05: R(P2_WSTAR_SECAGG / P2_WSTAR) is EQUIVALENT to 100 iff its 90% paired user-bootstrap percentile CI lies inside [99, 101]; the 95% CI and the ordinary claim rule are reported beside it
